title: potentilla egedii subsp. grandis
intro: Potentilla egedii subsp. grandis, commonly known as Icelandic cinquefoil, is a plant species that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla egedii subsp. grandis include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. However, due to limited research, more studies are needed to confirm the full extent of its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
